name: pixelfx
cost: Free (MIT), commercial use included. The Patch Pixel font is not covered
works_with: Browser games (canvas, Phaser, PixiJS, Kaplay, three.js), any engine through sprite sheets, Claude Code
short: 244 pixel art effects written as small pieces of code, with sprite sheet export and an AI skill for making new ones.
what: Fire, explosions, magic, weather, UI pops, pickups, critters and more, each one a file in `src/fx/<category>/<name>.js` with no images. You can play them in a browser game, recolor and mirror them, or export sprite sheets for engines like Godot and Unity. Effects that involve a character come with timing for the wind-up, hit freeze and recovery, and a skill teaches your agent to find, export and make effects.
who: Indie game developers who want ready effects or a way to make their own with an agent. If you don't make games, there is little here for you.
needs: Node.js, to run the tools in `tools/`
For the skill: Claude Code, or any agent that reads skills from `~/.claude/skills/`

steps.title: Add it to a browser game
steps.text: No dependencies. You can also copy `src/core` and the effects you want instead.

steps.title: Export a sprite sheet for any engine
steps.text: This writes a transparent PNG of every frame and an Aseprite-style JSON. `node tools/sheets.mjs` exports the whole library to `sheets/`.

steps.title: Recolor an effect
steps.text: Any effect takes a dark-to-bright palette of hex colors, so a fire can burn blue.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.text: Run this in Claude Code, or copy `skills/pixelfx` into `~/.claude/skills/`.

steps.title: Make your own effect
steps.text: Look at the contact sheet, fix the worst thing, render again. `node tools/serve.mjs` runs the gallery locally with your effects in it.
steps.code:
node tools/new.mjs arcane/my-spell       # a working starting point (add --loop for a loop)
node tools/render.mjs arcane/my-spell    # records/arcane/my-spell/contact.png: look at it
node tools/check.mjs arcane/my-spell     # spills, seams, unseeded randomness, slow frames

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Make five takes on a coin pickup sparkle and show me the best two." Or: "This hit effect feels floaty. Make it punchier."

watch: Effects drawn on the body paint the stock grey dummy. If you ship those with your own character, regenerate them.
Parts are adapted from Hugo Duprez's and Hollow Crown's MIT code. See NOTICE.md for what the licence does not cover.
